remarks:
A lot of love many improvements went into this one-of-a-kind timber frame home. 117 acres. Beautiful
views. Tranquility and privacy at high elevation. Head inside and you're greeted by updated hardwood
floors and abundant natural light in the spacious gourmet kitchen and living room, perfect for hosting large
gatherings. *1 Bedroom has a beautiful view of the pond and high elevation scenery. Other bdrm has full
view of across the hills at high elevation. Front yard also has beautiful scenic view of the other side of the
hills. Trails for Hunting or ATV's.

2021 Updates: Hardwood floors downstairs. Custom kitchen with high-end appliances and cabinets. New
furnace, hot water tank, new well, new propane tank, pex plumbing lines, remodeled downstairs bathroom
with shower, tile floor, laundry room with tile and cabinets. Updated electrical. Installed over-sized patio
door slider in the spacious family room w/ cathedral ceiling, which looks out to the pond and barn. Vinyl
siding w/gutters, front porch w/front door, lights, tile front foyer. Walk-in pantry. 2nd floor-laminate flooring. 2026 new thermal pane windows. 2025 asphalt driveway. 2024 edging stones. SQFT is owner verified.
